rules.statement: In a partition action, the court must examine each party's title and determine which of the orders mentioned in section 26 should be made.
rules.supporting_quote: "On the date fixed for the trial of a partition action or on any other date to which the trial may be adjourned, the court shall examine the title of each party and shall hear and receive evidence in support thereof and shall try and determine all questions of law and fact arising in that action in regard to the right, share, or interest of each party to, of, or in the land to which that action relates, and shall consider and decide which of the orders mentioned in section 26 should be made."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 25 of the Partition Act No. 16 of 1951
